booking.instructions: Call 858-256-1437 to schedule an appointment, or leave your details here and we'll follow up by email.

fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Dent Aid at 858-256-1437 or smile@dentaiddentistry.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.a: We accept all major dental insurance plans, as well as Medi-Cal and Denti-Cal. No insurance? We also offer in-house membership plans so quality care stays accessible. Call 858-256-1437 and we'll help you check your coverage.
Yes - we offer same-day crowns and same-day veneers using modern technology, so many restorations are completed in a single visit.
Yes - Dr. Abdulaali (Dr. Z) has advanced training in implant, prosthetic and cosmetic dentistry, and restoring smiles with dental implants is some of his favorite work.
Yes - we provide children's dentistry and care for patients of all ages, so your whole family can be looked after in one place.

faqs.q: Can you help with a dental emergency?
faqs.a: Yes - we keep time open in our schedule every day for dental emergencies. Call 858-256-1437 as early as you can and we'll get you taken care of.
Yes - Dent Aid is a veteran-founded practice, and our care is built on respect, honesty and a commitment to serving our community. We warmly welcome military families.
We're in Tierrasanta and welcome patients from San Carlos, Allied Gardens, Mission Valley, and communities across greater San Diego.
